help: 🤖 Claude on Telegram Any text goes to the active session. Photos and files are attached to it. Access /{{password}} <password> — unlock the bot /{{lock}} — lock it now Sessions /{{change}} — choose the session (or /{{change}} name) Answers from other sessions are kept (📬) and delivered when you switch. /{{repos}} — projects; open a new session /{{status}} — active session, model and context /{{screen}} — show the terminal now /{{cancel}} — interrupt Claude Claude Code /model — change model (or /model opus) /effort — effort level (or /effort high) /usage — plan usage /clear — clear the session context /{{lang}} — language The bot locks itself after {{hours}} h without use and whenever it restarts.
